foreignObject.div: Diffuser: 6–8 drops in diffuser. Room spray: 15 drops in 100mL water.
External use only. Avoid direct UV sunlight on applied skin for 12 hours.

g.text: Store below 30°C in a cool, dark space.
Keep tightly sealed in amber UV glass.
"Pure botanical connection, bottled for your daily ritual."

foreignObject.div:
Active Formulation:
100% Pure Citrus sinensis (Sweet Orange) Peel Oil.
Formulated without phthalates, synthetic fragrance, parabens, sulfates, mineral oil, or GMOs.
